comments.text: June 4th 1920; Treaty of Trianon, still hurts today as a Hungarian, very much! A punishment for us because French govt. and people feared Great Hungary with 20 million people and their soldiers would be later a treat against the so-called French Empire (that country , that exploited every single country it could). Told in books, "Especially if Hungarians unites again with Germans" thus they took away 70% of our land, they planned those lands must be full of value, minerals etc. and ripped out of the mother country around 5-10 million people that time. Unfortunately today, we are not a population of 20 million worldwide but only 14-15 million. VESSZEN TRIANON!
